changelog: Claude Desktop gateway stability fix: adds an internal tool contract / bounded repair loop for explicit tool_choice and readonly file checks without injecting contract notes into user prompts; synthesizes safe readonly file tool_use calls when a concrete file path and read-like tool are available; synthesizes a narrow safe git status tool_use after an authorized continuation when the previous assistant turn explicitly planned git status and a shell-like tool exists; avoids hard contract errors for broad continuation turns; reduces fake tool-result narration, large-context stream timeouts, preserves image tool results, and avoids concurrent account overload that can trigger 429 retry storms.
